tasks.name: Movie CRUD with status lifecycle and deletion guard

Support advanced list search: by title, genre, status, language, age rating, release date with server-side pagination. Page 7-8.

tasks.name: Cinema branches, screening rooms, and seat layout generator
tasks.summary: Manage cinema branches and rooms; generate seat layout from row/column config; restrict layout changes after future sold tickets exist.
tasks.details: Branch: code, name, address, city, contact, opening/closing time, status. Room: roomCode, roomName, type, capacity, status, belongs to active branch. Seat layout generator accepts row labels, column count, seat type mapping, blocked/aisle positions. Individual seat edits allowed (type, blocked, position) while safe. Layout change blocked if any future showtime has active hold or sold ticket — return dependency error. Seat preview shows rows, columns, VIP/standard/blocked legend. Page 8-9.

tasks.name: Showtime creation with end-time calculation and room-overlap prevention

Overlap check includes active showtimes AND cleaning buffer. Creating a showtime copies room seats into showtime_seats table. UI previews end time before save. Page 9.

tasks.name: Bulk showtime creation, cancellation, and update restrictions
tasks.summary: Generate repeated showtime schedules by date range/weekdays/time slots; cancel with booking impact evaluation; restrict core field edits after paid tickets.
tasks.details: Bulk create: date range, weekday selection, time slots — validate each generated slot for overlap and report invalid rows with reason. Cancellation: if paid tickets exist, those bookings become refund candidates. After paid tickets, movie/room/time fields are locked; update requires cancel+recreate flow. Showtime statuses: SCHEDULED, SELLING, SOLD_OUT, CANCELLED, COMPLETED. Page 9.

tasks.name: Showtime seat map display, seat selection, and temporary hold with Redis lock
tasks.summary: Display live seat map with AVAILABLE/HELD/SOLD/BLOCKED status; create temporary seat hold with TTL using Redis distributed lock and DB unique constraint to prevent duplicates.
tasks.details: Seat map statuses: AVAILABLE, HELD, SOLD, BLOCKED. Sold/blocked/held-by-other seats are disabled. Default TTL 5 minutes (configurable). Hold stores customer, showtime, seats, expiry. Prevent duplicates using Redis SET NX lock per showtimeSeatId + DB unique constraint. Limit one active hold per user/showtime. Hold response: holdId, expiresAt, selected seats. Page 10.

tasks.name: Hold expiry cleanup and near-real-time seat map refresh

tasks.details: Expired holds: set hold status EXPIRED, mark showtime_seats back to AVAILABLE. Scheduler runs every minute (configurable). WebSocket preferred for real-time push; polling acceptable fallback. Creating a new hold auto-cancels expired previous hold for same user/showtime. Page 10-11.

tasks.name: Cinema booking creation, server-side pricing, and payment recording
tasks.summary: Create cinema booking from active hold with server-authoritative total (tickets + combos - promotion + fees); record payment success/failure; issue one ticket per seat with signed QR payload.
tasks.details: Booking requires active non-expired hold. Total calculated server-side: sum ticket prices + combos - promotion discount + fees. On payment SUCCESS: booking → PAID, showtime_seats → SOLD, hold → CONVERTED, tickets ISSUED. On payment FAILURE: status FAILED with reason; booking stays PENDING until expiry. Each ticket: unique code, QR payload = ticketCode + HMAC signature. Page 11.
acceptanceCriteria: Booking cannot be created from expired or released hold
Server-calculated total is source of truth; client total ignored
Payment success triggers PAID booking, SOLD seats, ISSUED tickets atomically
Ticket count equals booked seat count
QR payload verifiable by signature

tasks.name: QR-based ticket check-in with duplicate and window guards

Already-checked-in ticket returns previous check-in info, not success. Out-of-window returns CHECKIN_WINDOW_CLOSED. REFUNDED/CANCELLED/INVALID tickets cannot check in. Page 11-12.
